notes: Solved independently with side a: two adjacent masses give perpendicular forces Gm2/a2 each, resultant sqrt(2)Gm2/a2 along the diagonal; the diagonal mass at distance a*sqrt(2) adds Gm2/(2a2) along the same direction, so F = (2sqrt(2)+1)/2 * Gm2/a2. Equating to (2sqrt(2)+1)/32 * Gm2/L2 gives a2 = 16L2, a = 4L. Every printed line checked with sympy and follows from the one above; step 3 has already multiplied both sides by 2 while cancelling, which is an equivalent equation, not a false one.
